title: Insight editor scene instance check using synchronous reducers instead of insightLogicRef
answers: Why does selecting a chart type in the insight editor trigger an unwanted auto-save?
Why does the insight editor exit edit mode with 'Insight updated' when changing chart types?
How to prevent race conditions when checking scene ownership in isInsightSceneInstance?
body:
Symptom: Selecting a new chart type in the insight editor auto-saves the insight and exits edit mode with an "Insight updated" message without clicking Save.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/insights/insightDataLogic.tsx:isInsightSceneInstance checked insightLogicRef, which is mounted asynchronously by a listener and lags behind synchronous URL matching reducers.
Fix pattern: Check synchronously updated reducers (insightId and dashboardId) instead of asynchronously mounted logic references (insightLogicRef) to verify scene instance identity.
Constraints: Applies when validating scene membership during or immediately after scene mount; does not apply when interaction with the mounted logic instance itself is required.
